discovery: Experimental discovery of the Higgs boson through the conception and construction of the ATLAS and CMS detectors at the LHC
motivation: The 2013 Prize honoured the theoretical prediction of the Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism. The experimental discovery that confirmed it has not yet been recognised. Della Negra and Virdee conceived the Compact Muon Solenoid and led it from its founding concept, including its crystal electromagnetic calorimeter and 4-tesla solenoid, to data taking. Jenni did the same for ATLAS. Their detector concepts, made to resolve the H→γγ and H→ZZ*→4ℓ channels at unprecedented luminosity, were the decisive instrumental innovations behind the independent 5σ observations announced on 4 July 2012. Their leadership turned thousands of physicists into collaborations able to make discoveries, and it produced the instruments that established the Higgs boson as the first elementary scalar. Those instruments now measure its couplings to percent-level precision and open a window on physics beyond the Standard Model.
